ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, OC is the bisector of $\angle AOB$, OD bisects $\angle AOC$, and $\angle COD=20^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle AOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $OD$ bisects $\angle AOC$ and $\angle COD = 20^\circ$, we can deduce that $\angle AOC = 2\angle COD = 40^\circ$, \\ 
and since $OC$ is the bisector of $\angle AOB$, it follows that $\angle AOB = 2\angle AOC = 80^\circ$. \\
Therefore, $\angle AOB = \boxed{80^\circ}$.
